step1_analysis.description: A resistive voltage divider with a feedforward capacitor used in a Low-Dropout (LDO) regulator. It scales down the output voltage for the error amplifier and introduces a left-half-plane zero to improve the loop phase margin and transient response.

paper_reference.title: A Capacitor-Free CMOS Low-Dropout Regulator With Damping-Factor-Control Frequency Compensation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming equal resistors for a typical 1.8V to 0.9V step-down to the reference voltage.

zero_frequency.description: Frequency of the left-half-plane zero introduced by CF1

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical feedback resistor values (100k) and the paper's reported 5pF capacitance.
The pole is formed by the parallel combination of R1 and R2 interacting with C1.

transient_overshoot.description: Overshoot percentage at the feedback node during a fast input step

sky130_expected.reasoning: High-frequency gain is 1 (due to CF1 shorting R1), while DC gain is 0.5. A full step will initially pass completely to Vx before settling.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC feedback factor, zero frequency, pole frequency, and step response of the LDO feedback network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LDO Feedback Network Testbench

.param R1_val=100k
.param R2_val=100k
.param C1_val=5p

* DUT (Values parameterized to fix extraction syntax)
RF1 Vs Vx {R1_val}
RF2 Vx GND {R2_val}
CF1 Vs Vx {C1_val}

* Stimulus
V_Vs Vs GND DC 1.8 AC 1
V_GND GND 0 0

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 10Meg
  let gain_mag = v(Vx)/v(Vs)
  let phase = 180/PI * (cph(v(Vx)) - cph(v(Vs)))
  
  * Measure DC feedback factor at low frequency (1kHz)
  meas ac dc_feedback_factor find gain_mag at=1k
  
  * Measure zero frequency (approximate by phase reaching 10 degrees)
  meas ac zero_frequency when phase=10 rise=1
  
  * Measure pole frequency (approximate by phase returning to 10 degrees)
  meas ac pole_frequency when phase=10 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  * Step Vs from 0 to 1.8V to observe feedforward effect
  alter V_Vs = pulse(0 1.8 1n 1n 1n 10u 20u)
  tran 1n 5u
  meas tran vx_max max v(Vx)
  meas tran vx_final find v(Vx) at=4u
  let overshoot_pct = (vx_max - vx_final)/vx_final * 100
  print overshoot_pct
  
  quit
.endc
.end
